name: Create Reservation

overview.en: [excited] Let's create an Inventory Reservation! Think of this... as holding specific products for a customer. [friendly] We just link a pool, pick a customer, and set the dates. Easy!
overview.hi: [excited] चलिए एक Inventory Reservation बनाते हैं! इसे... किसी customer के लिए specific products hold करने की तरह सोचिए। [friendly] हमें बस एक pool link करना है, customer चुनना है, और dates set करनी हैं। आसान है!

explanation.en: [casual] First, pick the inventory pool. Let's go with... voice-demo.
explanation.hi: [casual] सबसे पहले, inventory pool चुनें। चलिए... voice-demo लेते हैं।

explanation.en: [casual] Now, search for the customer. Let's use... voice-demo.
explanation.hi: [casual] अब, customer को search करें। चलिए... voice-demo use करते हैं।

explanation.en: [curious] What's the type? FIXED, FLEXIBLE, or ROTATIONAL? Let's pick FIXED.
explanation.hi: [curious] type क्या है? FIXED, FLEXIBLE, या ROTATIONAL? चलिए FIXED चुनते हैं।

explanation.en: [casual] When does the reservation kick in? Pick the start date and time.
explanation.hi: [casual] reservation कब से शुरू होती है? start date और time चुनें।

explanation.en: [casual] And when does it end? Pick the end date and time.
explanation.hi: [casual] और यह कब खत्म होती है? end date और time चुनें।

explanation.en: [excited] Now we allocate quantities! This auto-pulls from the active agreement. Let's look at the items.
explanation.hi: [excited] अब हम quantities allocate करते हैं! यह active agreement से automatically आता है। चलिए items देखते हैं।

explanation.en: [casual] How much of this product are we reserving? Just type the number.
explanation.hi: [casual] इस product का कितना reserve कर रहे हैं? बस number type करें।

explanation.en: [casual] How much do they ALREADY have? Enter that quantity here.
explanation.hi: [casual] उनके पास पहले से कितना है? वो quantity यहाँ डालें।

nodes.label: Notes
nodes.demoValue: Standard inventory reservation for voice demo.

explanation.en: [casual] Any special instructions? Jot them down here.
explanation.hi: [casual] कोई special instructions हैं? यहाँ लिख दें।

wrapUp.en: [warm and satisfied] And that's a wrap! [chuckles] Your reservation is set up. Nothing was saved here... but whenever you're ready, go reserve some REAL inventory. You've got this!
wrapUp.hi: [warm and satisfied] और यह हो गया! [chuckles] आपकी reservation set हो गई है। यहाँ कुछ भी save नहीं हुआ... लेकिन जब भी तैयार हों, जाइए और REAL inventory reserve करें। आप यह कर सकते हैं!

description: Walkthrough for creating a new inventory reservation
